history: always-repro'd across the 19 SPIR-V-capable stable releases v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607; v1.4.1907 is unprobeable because its package has no SPIR-V backend
summary: Still reproduces on main and all 19 SPIR-V-capable stable releases. The v1.6.2106 capture matches the reporter's 64-line module exactly. Tex0/SS0 keep DescriptorSet/Binding decorations because their sample feeds a branch whose two targets both end in OpKill; Tex1/SS1 are eliminated. At -O0 all four survive, showing that the observed elimination comes from spirv-opt rather than the emitter, consistent with the maintainer comment placing a fix there. The module is correct but not minimal, so this is an accepted optimization enhancement rather than a correctness bug.
title: [SPIR-V] Not all unnecessary bindings are eliminated using SPIR-V backend
